title: Deep tone pass over ALL source comments (Rust + Lean), following .design/tone-comment-pass-plan.md and .design/tone-and-voice.md as authoritative. One crate at a time in the plan's order (thermite-verified → thermite-spec → thermite-syntax → thermite-tv → lean → thermite-lower → forge). Edit COMMENTS ONLY — no code, identifiers, string literals, test expectations, status labels (SHIPPED/NOT-STARTED, enum variants), or schema text (doc-drift audited-sha blocks). Apply the claim-by-claim 'exactly' judgment. Self-verify each crate before moving on: git diff shows only comment-line changes, cargo test -p <crate> green, lean/ leaves lake build unaffected; revert any non-comment change. Commit per crate so progress survives a timeout. One PR for the pass. If low on time/budget, STOP at a crate boundary and report which crates are done. Out of scope: .design subdir docs and the already-merged public docs (README/RATIONALE/thermite-design, docs/). Never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json.
